WITH currency_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    feecoin,
    AVG(CASE WHEN rebtotal > 0 THEN rebtotal ELSE NULL END) as avg_rebtotal,
    AVG(CASE WHEN feerate > 0 AND rebrate > 0 THEN (rebrate - feerate) / feerate ELSE NULL END) as avg_gap
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY feecoin
),
benchmark_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) as benchmark
  FROM currency_stats
  WHERE avg_rebtotal IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.feecoin,
    cs.avg_rebtotal,
    cs.avg_gap,
    bc.benchmark,
    cs.avg_rebtotal - bc.benchmark as exceeds
  FROM currency_stats cs, benchmark_calc bc
  WHERE cs.avg_rebtotal > bc.benchmark
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_rebtotal) as avg_of_avg_rebates,
  AVG(avg_gap) as avg_of_avg_gaps,
  AVG(exceeds) as avg_exceeds_benchmark
FROM filtered_stats
